descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de echipamente pentru HVAC și refrigerare
The Full-Stack Developer will support the internal development and continuous improvement of
 our client's global e-commerce platforms based on Shopware 6 and headless technologies.
 The role includes developing backend and frontend functionality, supporting integrations with
 ERP, PIM and other third-party systems, improving existing features and contributing to new
 applications and digital services.
 The developer will work closely with other internal developers, Product Owners, business
 stakeholders and external development partners in an agile environment.
 Responsibilities 
 • Develop and maintain e-commerce functionality based on Shopware 6, PHP/Symfony,
 Vue 3, Nuxt 3 and TypeScript.
 • Implement backend and frontend features within our headless e-commerce architecture.
 • Develop and maintain REST API integrations with ERP, PIM and other third-party systems.
 • Support the development and maintenance of Shopware plugins and extensions.
 • Contribute to the development of new digital applications, online tools and e-commerce
 services.
 • Analyse bugs and technical issues and implement sustainable solutions.
 • Participate in code reviews and follow agreed development standards.
 • Write maintainable, documented and testable code.
 • Work with Docker-based development environments and Git-based workflows.
 • Support CI/CD processes and deployments together with the development team.
 • Contribute to performance, SEO, accessibility and security improvements.
 • Cooperate with internal developers and external development partners.
 • Participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, refinement and estimations.
 • Support testing and troubleshooting during releases and platform rollouts.
 • Continuously improve technical knowledge and gradually take ownership of larger development areas.
 • Expected focus approximately 70–80% backend and 20–30% frontend, depending on project requirements.
 Requirements: 
 • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable technical education is preferred; equivalent practical experience is also acceptable.
 • Approximately 2-4 years of professional software development experience.
 • Experience with backend development using PHP 8.x, ideally with Symfony.
 • Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development.
 • Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
 • E-commerce experience is preferred.
 • Shopware 6 experience is an advantage but not mandatory.
 • Good spoken and written English.
 Backend - PHP / Symfony / Shopware 
 • Good knowledge of PHP 8.x.
 • Good understanding of Symfony or comparable PHP frameworks.
 • Understanding of object-oriented programming principles and common design patterns.
 • Experience developing and consuming REST APIs.
 • Experience with MySQL/MariaDB.
 • Understanding of database queries, migrations and transactions.
 • Shopware 6 experience with plugins, events, DAL, Store API or migrations is a strong advantage.
 Frontend - Vue / Nuxt / TypeScript 
 • Experience with JavaScript / TypeScript.
 • Experience with Vue.js, preferably Vue 3.
 • Knowledge of Nuxt 3 is preferred.
 • Understanding of SSR and modern frontend development.
 • Experience with REST API-based frontend applications.
 • Knowledge of responsive design and CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS.
